title.rendered: Top 10 Air Conditioners to Buy in Summer 2018

content.rendered:
The economic growth of India and the increasing power parity of purchasing have made it possible for the average earning middle-class families to afford a healthy and comfortable lifestyle. If we talk about air conditioners, they were once considered as a mark of luxury, not a long time ago, but now they have found a good place in almost all the middle-class households. This true for not only in the metro cities but also in the small cities, with the inception of foreign companies and the introduction of newer technologies, benefits of healthcare and energy efficiency, consumers all around have become more aware and they now understand their necessities. The industrial boom and competitive market prices have made possible a wide variety of brands that offer a different product to choose from. Experts in the industry and the analysts have projected that energy efficiency, healthcare, and innovation would be the three commandments that’ll guide the consumers buying behavior. With the ambition to grasp to cover the huge India market, many brands are now launching the high energy efficient air conditioners with five-star ratings that are designed exceptionally. These include many value-added features that developed especially for the Indian market; these are based on the local climatic patterns, health conditions and the consumer requirements. Apart from being able to cool efficiently, these new-age air conditioners are also highly innovative and have features like air purification, humidity control. A newly launched feature, that says to repel mosquitoes in an efficient and non-toxic way around you to ensure a sound sleep, this is especially required in the seasons where serious and hazardous epidemics like malaria, dengue are at their peak. There are various important factors that you should consider before buying an air conditioner this summer. They are:

Required Capacity:

The capacity of your air conditioner ought to be considered with a precision that shall depend on the size of the floor of the room, the AC is required for. Taking a rough measure, an area in the range of: 120 to 140 Sq. ft. would need 1-ton air conditioner cooling capacity 150 to 180 Sq. ft. an area will require 1.5-ton air conditioner cooling capacity and, 180 to 240 Sq. ft. an area will require 2-ton air conditioner cooling capacity.

The Energy Efficiency:

With rising temperature levels today and with the increasing electricity tariffs, an air conditioner model of high energy efficiency is a must-buy. It is made mandatory for all air conditioners have a sticker on them to indicate with star rated energy efficiency; this is also called EER that has been standardized by the regulatory Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE). Thus, a unit with more number stars shall consume lesser electricity in comparison with one with a lower star rating.

What To Buy? Split Or Window AC in 2018?

Now another important deciding factor is to understand what you really want. Whether you want a window air conditioner or a split model, although, window units are cheaper in comparison and they are easy to install, split air conditioners are quieter. Split air conditioners are aesthetically more pleasing and they provide a better air distribution.

The Money Matters:

Price is perhaps the most concerned factor. An air conditioner to contain more features and higher star ratings would account for a higher price tag on it. It is taken as estimation that for every increase in the star rating, there is an approximate increase of around Rs 2,500. Moreover, an Inverter air conditioner is usually priced at 20% higher as compared to a 5-Star rated Split air conditioner.

Quality Of Air:

The quality of indoor air is a very important factor while deploying ACs at home; thus an AC with a good filter is highly important to improve the indoor air quality. A good filter not only just ensures clean air, but it also enhances the cooling performance and the energy efficiency of the air conditioner by preventing the evaporator coil from choking due to dust.

Installation Requirements:

A window AC is made to be compact; it’s designed to be attached to the windows. While a split AC has one compressor unit outside of the house and an indoor unit which is fixed inside the room, this is specifically designed to achieve a better flow of air. It is should be made sure that the installation is done from an authorized service center. The parameter of a performance of the AC depends a lot on a good or bad installation.

Cleaning & Maintenance:

ACs are like cars, and just like cars, they need regular servicing for them to remain in the best of their condition and for an optimum performance. Once installed, there ought to be regular servicing, preferably every three months.

The Cooling Speed:

The air conditioner must have an adjustable thermostat (for temperature setting) and that should have at least two cooling speeds, that’s a minimum of two fan speeds, it’s that, you may want to have variable speeds for different times in a day. Moreover, a setting for energy efficiency would be a beneficial addition. This shall help in saving the consumption of energy and providing optimum cooling.

After Sales Services:

After sales services and check other add-on features such as warranty would there certainly be a plus for the purchase. Look for a brand that’s service oriented and has the capabilities and a good network to meet the servicing needs of your product.

Other Features:

Most air-conditioning units(ac units) come with a function of dehumidification. This reduces humidity in the air, for the purpose of increased cooling and more comfort. It is also important to check the levels of noise of the model, which may range from 19 to 60 decibels.  The sleep mode function in an air conditioner is useful in such a case as it automatically adjusts the required temperature during the night. The unit should also have a facility for an auto restart, this helps to restore the last setting that was made before any power break.

Usefulness:

Nowadays, the air conditioner is not just used only for cooling, but as a multi-seasonal product that can also be used during winters for heating. In addition to their usefulness, these Hot and Cold ACs also save up to 35 % more energy than heaters. Air conditioners are also considered as the best cooling devices for humid atmospheres. Special functions for cooling are required for the optimum cooling and maximum levels of comfort during monsoons. Hence, it is advised to look for an AC with features that can control humidity and give out more comfort in Monsoons as well.

Some Tips And Tricks:

Consider the below factors before deciding on Which Air Conditioner you should Buy in 2018.

Exposure to Sunlight & Heat:

If your room is closer to the kitchen or the wall of your room is directly exposed to the sun, you will need an air conditioner with higher cooling capacity.

Brand:

You should wisely choose an air conditioner brand, which fulfills your need of maximum energy saving through highest EER, extensive after-sales service and best cooling performance. The air conditioner you choose should have functions, which provide faster cooling in summers, best comfort in monsoon and protects from disease-causing infection, allergens and insects like Mosquitoes, etc.

Room Size:

The size/volume of the AC should be as per the size of your room. If it is bigger, it will not be able to provide suitable dehumidification and the smaller one will cost you more in terms of energy consumption. Room ACs are obtainable in the capacity range of 0.75 to 2-ton. Inverter AC with adjustable tonnage can be used for a wider range of room sizes/volumes.

Weather Conditions:

While choosing one should look for air conditioners that can work capably even in the extreme weather conditions of Indian summers.

Usage:

If your AC usage is 8 to 10Hrs a day for 3 to 4 months, it is suggested to buy at least 3-Star rated AC. In case, AC usage is extended for 5 to 7 months, you should opt for 5-Star rated AC. For usage of 10 to 12 months, one should opt for cooling only or cold & hot Inverter AC. Make a smart investment this summer by selecting an air conditioner that meets your above requirements and offers you a pleasure of ownership.

Advantages And Disadvantages Of Air Conditioners:

Air conditioners are the finest way of beating the scorching summer heat. They can be helpful in making the hot summer days manageable and improve the indoor air quality. By altering the temperature of the air conditioner according to your needs, you can feel contented in all seasons. However, air conditioners can also raise the risk of certain health problems, mainly when you fail to maintain and clean them properly. This article explains the major advantages and disadvantages of using air conditioners.

Advantages of an Air Conditioner:

Below are the Advantages of Air Conditioner for your Health and lifestyle.

Prevents Heat And Dehydration Strokes

Being exposed to excessive heat for long times can cause dehydration. This is because high temperature leads to generous sweating and makes your body lose water. If you fail to replenish this lost water, the consequence will be dehydrated. Since air conditioners reduce sweating, they can minimize the risk of water loss and dehydration. Heat strokes are the other problem that excessive heat can cause. This is because too much heat makes it difficult for the body to adjust its temperature. Failing to treat this problem quickly enough can cause damage to the brain &other organs of the body. Since air conditioners reduce the temperature of the air, they can be obliging in preventing heat strokes.

Improves The Air Quality

Air conditioners can significantly improve indoor air quality & create a much healthier atmosphere. As they are capable of filtering out dust, pollen& other allergens present in the environment. By reducing humidity, air conditioners can check the growth of mildew and mold.

Reduce Asthma And Allergies

Air conditions can help to filter as well as disinfect the air that we respire. This can help to reduce the risk of asthma attacks and allergies by removing pollen and dust, and preventing the growth of mildew & mold. Being exposed to mold is one of the main aspects that increase the risk of asthma attacks, allergic reactions, and other respiratory issues. The fact that we close our windows while using air conditioners helps to avoid the entry of environmental allergens, bacteria, and dust.

Disadvantages Of An Air Conditioner:

Below are the disadvantages of an Air Conditioner for your Health and Lifestyle.

Skin Dryness

Spending the bigger amount of time in an air-conditioned room can make your skin lose its moisture, thereby becoming sensitive and dry. It can also cause irritation & dryness of mucous membranes.

Aggravation Of Respiratory Problems

A quick change in temperature has shown to exacerbate the symptoms of various respiratory diseases. Fortunately, you can significantly lessen the risk of this problem by setting a higher temperature& decreasing it gradually.

Respiratory Tract Infections And Allergies

Not cleaning the air conditioner can cause the accumulation of dust, bacteria, and pollen in the air filters. This will significantly raise the risk of asthma attacks and respiratory tract infections. Being exposed to the cool air-conditioned air for too long can lead to a sore throat, runny nose, sinus problems, & other similar symptoms. Some air conditioners do not have the ability to humidify the air, thereby making the air very dry. Dry air can end in irritation of the lining of the mouth and the nose. The best way of decreasing the risks associated with the use of air conditioners is to have them cleaned on a regular basis. A clean &well-maintained air conditioner will have more health advantages and few disadvantages.

The Air And Your Health

Everybody is subject to basic environmental conditions, which need management. Even people in excellent health can suffer from temperatures & the invisible airborne particles which are existing in every building and human environment. Fumes, insecticides, stale air, and other problems are to be managed. Even the basic odors are the symptoms of needing better air quality. A smell directs chemically active particles in the air. These issues are not necessarily toxic, but they do not do much for your breathing. A new air conditioner can solve all of these problems.

Temperatures And Comfort

Fatigue can be caused by excessive cold or heat. You can get minor, but repetitive conditions like headaches, colds, coughing, discomfort, and other elusive symptoms. Temperatures and humidity affect how the body works. Too much cold or heat can use up energy, quite rapidly in some cases. You may feel tired, and not be sure why. You can get dehydration from a low humid environment, or from an environment, which is too humid, which, in return makes you lose water as your body tries to adjust to the environment.

Long-Term Benefits Of Air Conditioning

Continuous, repetitive stress on your body does not make your immune system much good, either. Over long periods, the result is wearing down your resistance to these nuisance conditions, making you more vulnerable to the infections. On the other hand, long-term air conditioning, also reduces stresses over a period, allowing full recovery, & ending the repetitive cycle of conditions. Simply installing a dependable air conditioning system can make all the difference. You will notice the improvement instantly!

How To Choose Good Air Conditioner For Office/Home?

There are various brands available in the market, which offers high-quality home appliance with great price benefits. Brands like Blue Star, Samsung, Voltas, Onida, Lloyd, Hitachi, Daikin, LG, Haier, whirlpool &several more brands are giving strong competition to each other. We have itemized those high performance & energy efficient Air Conditioners after seeing below criteria’s. Do check out the apiece criteria mentioned below and consider how to choose air conditioner in India.

Capacity: –

Depends on your room dimension (where you want to install a new air conditioner), you can choose the capacity of the Air Conditioner required accordingly. How to measure the vital capacity of your room? Well, it is quite simple. You need to compute a bit by following the below-mentioned formula and calculate what capacity of Air Conditioner will be required in your room.

Required Tonnage of Air Conditioner = Height X Floor size/Length of your room X Width.

That is if your total room size is 100 or less than 100sq. ft., you need1-ton Ac in your room. Beyond 120 sq.ft. you need 1 5-ton Ac in your room.

Bureau Of Energy Efficiency Ratings: –

Bureau of Energy Efficiency Ratings (BEE) is compulsory to check as it is a measurement of how much energy efficiency is your AC. BEE India (Bureau of Energy Efficiency) gives home appliance ratings from 1 star (low) to 5 stars (high) based on their energy consumption perimeter. 5 star ratings Air Conditioners will be costly, but consumes less energy, while 3-star ratings Air Conditioners are cheaper in price but consumes more energy leading to more electricity bills.

Cooling speed: –

Cooling speed of the Air Conditioner is measured with the fan speed Air Conditioners provide. If it has three-speed levels, it is sufficient to cool your room in 10 to 15 minutes. We recommend you to choose the product with energy efficient settings and providing the measurably good speed settings.

Split Air Conditioner or Window Air Conditioners: –

Well, it is not too tough to answer a call. Windows, Air Conditioners are outdated, require more space, and consume more power. While Split Air Conditioners are cheaper in price, more powerful, consumes less energy and less space.

Installation charges: –

There are many Air Conditioner manufacturing companies, which provide free installation, but if a respectable brand does not provide free installation, you should better compromise with it, as installation charges are hardly INR 1000 to 1500.

Warranty: –

Warranty on the home appliances& electric products is most important to check. As there might occur some functioning problem or fault, in that case, calling customer service & get your product repaired is quite good.

Price: –

Price of the Air Conditioner is, of course, should be low; nevertheless, if you are going to buy 5-star rating air conditioner in India, you need to spend more money. While 3-star rating air conditioner is cheaper. In addition, brand-wise the price of Air Conditioners is getting differ. Blue Star, Voltas, and Daikin have bit costly Air Conditioners in the market while Samsung, Onida, LG, and other brands have low priced Air Conditioners.

Other Features: –

Do check features like Air Conditioners with HEPA filter (which provides clean air for you), auto clean mode, and sleeping mode, less noisy Air Conditioners and timer facility (which help you to save more energy). HEPA filter Air Conditioners can reduce your usage of the Air purifier in summer at least, & if you buy dual Air Air-Conditioners (HOT and Cold air), you may not need a room heater as well as winter.

These are the basic points/criteria you need to consider while purchasing a new Split Air Conditioners in India. Hope our buying guide will help you to choose the best product& long durable as well.
